name: cyberriskguardian
description: CyberRiskGuardian Core (Community Edition, free) - scenario-driven cybersecurity risk assessment, steps 1-11 of the 19-step CRG method: context and evidence intake, risk appetite, scenario generation (at least twenty candidates, typically 25-40), screening and selection, validated CRG quantification with CVSS v4.0, a quick scan and a management summary, with the label check for the three standard markers (book v2.51b).
